_meta.warning: Concentration and recovery figures below are illustrative DEMO values, not sourced from a certified ferro-alloy specification sheet or measured plant recovery data. Do not use for real charge-mix or procurement calculations.
_meta.schema_note: Each specification carries: id, name, target_element, concentration_pct (wt% of the target element within the alloy addition itself), recovery_pct (% of that element retained in the melt after addition), source, confidence, notes. Distinct from emission_factors.json's alloy_addition entries, which carry embodied CO2 per tonne of the same alloy rather than its element concentration/recovery.
_meta.unit: concentration_pct and recovery_pct are both wt%/%
